title: Storage template
purpose: Review one version of a recorded unit layout: its settings, the layout outline, units already created from it, other versions and history.
summary: One version of a recorded unit layout: its settings, layout outline, units created from it, other versions and history.

tasks.title: Change the layout
steps: Select [[New version]] once a unit has been created from this one, or [[Edit]] before that.

good_to_know: A version's layout is fixed once a unit has been created from it.
Each suffix is added after the new unit's code to make the codes.
Nominal temperature is a set point, not a measurement.

sections.title: Storage template
paragraphs: A template version's layout is fixed once a unit has been created from it. Until then it can be edited.

items.label: Code and version
items.description: The code is shared by every version.

items.label: Storage class
items.description: The storage class the recipe names, with its code; links to the class when it exists.

items.label: Technology
items.description: Technology from the recipe, for example LN2 vapor phase.

items.label: Nominal temperature
items.description: Stated set point in °C from the recipe, not a measurement.

items.label: Units created
items.description: Number of units created from this version.

sections.title: Layout
paragraphs: One row per rack, tower, shelf or canister, parents before children. Suffix is added after the new unit's code to make each code, for example VP-02 plus T01 gives VP-02-T01.

items.label: Level
items.description: Depth in the layout, from 1 to at most 4.

items.label: Slot
items.description: Place in the parent or unit.

items.label: Boxes
items.description: Box suffix, slot and container type version.

sections.title: Units created from this version
paragraphs: Units applied from this version, with room and status.

sections.title: Versions
paragraphs: Every version of this code; select another to open it.

items.label: Apply template
items.description: Active templates only. Opens the apply form.

items.label: New version
items.description: Opens the template form pre-filled from this version; saving with the same code creates the next version.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Opens the edit form for this version.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: The newest 50 recorded changes to this record, shown oldest to newest, each with its time, the person and the reason given. Setup entries carry no reason. History cannot be edited or deleted. With more than five entries the panel starts collapsed; select its heading to open or close it.
